title: The latest signal
overview: Today’s index contains 240 recent records. The strongest signals span Consciousness / philosophy, Neuroscience, Quantum physics. Treat the ranking as a reading priority, not a verdict: preprints and ambitious theoretical claims still require independent scrutiny.

items.title: Neural correlates of perceptual consciousness from within: A narrative review of human intracranial research
items.why_it_matters: Despite many years of research, the quest to identify neural correlates of perceptual consciousness (NCC) remains unresolved. One major obstacle lies in methodological limitations: most studies rely on non-invasive neural measures with limited spatial or temporal resolution, making it difficult to disentangle proper NCCs from concurrent cognitive processes.

items.title: EEG-CBF integration in calf slaughter neurophysiology: a narrative review
items.why_it_matters: Loss of consciousness (LOC) during calf slaughter is a neurophysiological process that requires distinction between cortical awareness and reflexive subcortical or spinal activity. Conscious perception depends on intact thalamocortical connectivity and integrated cortical function.

items.title: Quantum Interference and the Limits of Separability
items.why_it_matters: Abstract Quantum theory implies, and empirical evidence confirms, that while particles can exhibit wave-like behavior in interferometric experiments, this behavior is so limited as not to allow for third- and higher-order interference.
